card.title: GREEN HOWARDS
card.text: Draw a card when a unit becomes Veteran.
card.flavorText: During WWII, the Green Howards, or the Yorkshire Regiment, fielded 12 battalions that saw action across various theaters. The 1st Battalion fought in Sicily and Italy with the 5th Division, while the 2nd Battalion operated in Burma as part of the 26th Indian Infantry Division and the 82nd (West Africa) Division. The 4th and 5th Battalions were captured during the Battle of Gazala in North Africa, serving with the 50th (Northumbrian) Infantry Division. The 6th and 7th Battalions were duplicates formed for the Territorial Army, joining the 69th Brigade in France, North Africa, Sicily, and Northwest Europe. The 8th Battalion was initially formed for home defense, merging with the 13th Battalion and later becoming the 30th Battalion. It served in Italy and French North Africa. The 9th and 10th Battalions were initially for training and home defense but later participated in the Normandy campaign and operations in Northwest Europe. The 11th, 12th, and 13th Battalions were formed in 1940. The 12th Battalion transformed into an armored unit and later joined the Reconnaissance Corps, providing reinforcements to the 43rd Reconnaissance Regiment. After WWII the Green Howards continued to serve with the British Army until 2006, when it was merged into the Royal Yorkshire Regiment (14th/15th, 19th and 33rd/76th Foot) along with all other Yorkshire based regiments.
